Kerry and Gina are amazing help, but Jane and the others were no help but rude and asking questions when im not comfortable in telling, even after mentioning it to them. As patients we know how we feel when being unwell or seeking for help. We do not need Jane or people who have learnt from her to tell us how we feel.

I been with the surgery for 4 years and had no problems until now. Dr Ukarta may have the qualifications but he is not a Dr i ever want to see in my life, rushing and not listening to his patients. Not only myself but people i know have the same opinions.

Dr Ukarta jumps to conclusions without listening properly. Especially discussing about mental health or pregnancy, he has nothing to offer but his opinions was to go A&E. Other family and friends that has seen this dr has mentioned that he doesn’t seem to be bothered with our problems. He seems to be going into our records to put some notes down to say he has seen us but really has not helped.

I am not happy with the surgery as i was before. I would never recommend dr Ukarta.
